caption:
You went silent to keep the peace — and called it love. But the truest love is willing to tell you you're wrong. (Galatians 1:8-9 devotional)

You stayed quiet to keep the peace and named your silence love. But Paul would pronounce a curse even on an angel over a false gospel, because a counterfeit quietly kills the very people it fools. The same letter that curses the lie calls them “brothers” — the hard “no” that guards the gospel is the “yes” that keeps you.
